members.name: fov
members.description: Field of view in degrees. Ignored when orthogonal is true.

members.name: aspect
members.description: Aspect ratio multiplier applied on top of the scene's own aspect ratio.

members.name: orthogonal
members.description: If true, uses an orthogonal projection instead of a perspective one.

members.name: bgColor
members.description: The background clear color for this camera.

members.name: passes
members.description: Any custom render pass you want for this camera, add them here. By default, there's one pass that renders everything in group 0 on the "default" render target. Warning: if you create two cameras, make sure to change the output or it'll overwrite the previous camera render.

members.name: doFrustumCulling
members.description: Whether frustum culling is enabled for this camera (TODO, not fully implemented).

members.name: lightData
members.description: The light data associated with this camera. Handles all dynamic lighting visible by this camera, including ambient light. Normally handled internally by the camera and scene lights.

members.name: environment
members.description: If set, this camera will use a custom environment.

functions.name: update
functions.description: Updates the camera's view and projection matrices.

functions.name: render
functions.description: Renders every enabled pass on this camera for the given draw groups.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Destroys the camera and its light data.

functions.name: getScreenPoint
functions.description: Projects a world-space 3D point to Normalized Device Coordinate (NDC, aka Screen-Space Position). Note: the center is at (0,0) instead of (0.5, 0.5); use toFlixelScreenPoint() for flixel coordinates. Values are unclamped.

functions.name: toFlixelScreenPoint
functions.description: Converts an NDC point (from getScreenPoint) into flixel screen coordinates.

functions.name: getWorldSpace
functions.description: Re-projects a screen-space point to world space, useful for point-and-click in 3D with raycast.

functions.name: loadPassesFromAsset
functions.description: Loads and assigns render passes from an asset.
